stem: A test compares three new variants with control on one primary metric. The team wants the chance of any false positive across the three comparisons to stay at or below 5%. Which approach answers this?

options.text: Test each comparison at 0.05, just as for a single test
Test each comparison at 0.05 × 3, which is 0.15 in total
Test only the variant with the largest lift, at 0.05
